items.title: HNW specialist broker joins Coversure Network
items.summary: Insurance Age reports that a high-net-worth specialist broker has joined the Coversure Network.

items.title: LGPS professionals show growing appetite for gilts, Schroders survey reveals
items.summary: A survey by Schroders and Room151 indicates that the majority of Local Government Pension Scheme professionals are increasing or considering allocations to gilts as funding positions improve.
